title: Operations briefing - from alarm to repair, faster
summary: Self-playing briefing for shift leads and operations managers: why dispatching changes, the new dispatch console and the technician app shown on frames recorded from the two clickable prototypes (camera, cursor, clicks and keys), the most common questions and what the shift gains. Start screen with 'Start with narration' (browser speech reads each caption) or 'Browse without sound'; captions are exactly what is spoken; the current step lives in the address (#/<chapter>/<n>); a step that stands still shows its key frame. Keys: arrows, Space, C, M. Compact layout below 900 px of canvas.

items: Recorded: morning queue and detail panel
